meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的来源类型（网址、GitHub 仓库、PDF、视频等）自动选择抓取工具，把内容整理成 AI 技能，并可增强、打包或导出。
howto.when: 当你想从文档、GitHub 仓库、PDF 或视频等来源创建 AI 技能，或要求抓取、转换、打包文档供 AI 使用时触发。

say.text: 把这个 GitHub 仓库做成一个 AI 技能
say.note: 会抓取该仓库并生成技能包。

say.text: 把这个 PDF 转换为 AI 能用的技能
say.note: 会自动识别 PDF 并提取内容。

say.text: 根据这份文档更新现有技能
say.note: 会同步文档并刷新已有技能。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude automatically detects the source type (URL, GitHub repo, PDF, video, etc.), picks the matching scraper, and turns the content into an AI-ready skill; it can then enhance, package, or export it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to create an AI skill from a documentation site, GitHub repo, PDF, video, or other source, or ask to scrape, convert, or package documentation for AI.

say_en.text: Turn this GitHub repository into an AI skill.
say_en.note: It will scrape the repo and generate a skill package.

say_en.text: Convert this PDF into an AI-ready skill.
say_en.note: It will detect the PDF and extract its content.

say_en.text: Update the existing skill based on this documentation.
say_en.note: It will sync the docs and refresh the skill.
